---Run the scripts per step (2 steps)
--Step #1
DROP TABLE eds.BRANCH_DIM


--Step #2
CREATE TABLE eds.BRANCH_DIM
WITH (
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(SOL_ID)
)
AS
SELECT
    SOL.*
    ,AREA.SETID_SET_DESC AS AREA
    ,REGION.SETID_SET_DESC AS REGION
FROM eds.DEP_SERVICEOUTLETTABLE AS SOL
    LEFT JOIN eds.AREA_DIM AS AREA
        ON SOL.SOL_ID = AREA.SOLIDSET_SOL_ID
        AND SOL.BANK_ID = AREA.SOLIDSET_BANK_ID
        AND AREA.SOLIDSET_ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
        AND AREA.SOLIDSET_DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
    LEFT JOIN eds.REGION_DIM AS REGION
        ON SOL.SOL_ID = REGION.SOLIDSET_SOL_ID
        AND SOL.BANK_ID = REGION.SOLIDSET_BANK_ID
        AND AREA.SOLIDSET_ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
        AND AREA.SOLIDSET_DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
    INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL CTL
        ON CTL.DEPOSITS_DATE BETWEEN SOL.SCD_Start_Date AND SOL.SCD_End_Date
